criteria.criterion: A cancelled delete_issue_link (non-idempotent stderr) no longer increments links_applied — verified by a test asserting links_applied=0, links_failed=1.

A failed delete_issue_link with an idempotent marker (404/409/does-not-exist/not-found) on EITHER stream still counts applied — verified by tests asserting links_applied=1, links_failed=0 for the marker on stderr and again on stdout.
CalledProcessError with no marker on either stream counts failed — verified by test.
A failed set_relationship increments links_failed and does not unwind the pass — verified by a test asserting links_applied=0, links_failed=1 and normal return.
The RECON: batch_outcome line for an update includes links_failed=<n> — verified by a test capturing stderr and asserting the substring.
workitem link create and workitem link delete argv both include --yes — verified by a test asserting the flag is present in each command list.
test_update_one_tolerates_acli_delete_failure still asserts update_one does not raise, its count corrected to links_applied == 0, links_failed == 1.
